data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 落雪窗畔的暖茶守候
data.description: 窗外正悄无声息地飘着初冬细雪，温暖的卧室里放着舒缓的旧唱片。雪菜身着纯白细针织吊带长睡裙坐在飘窗软垫上，双手捧着热可可杯轻贴面颊，胸前的绒球缎带随呼吸起伏。她朝你露出一抹既温柔又隐隐怕冷的微笑，轻声留你多坐一会儿。
data.location: 窗外飘雪、室内暖意融融的卧室飘窗
data.action: 屈膝坐于飘窗软垫，双手捧热杯轻贴脸侧温柔相望
data.lighting: 室内柔和暖黄灯光与窗外清冷飞雪蓝调形成温柔对照
data.camera: 平视中近景，窗上微雾与杯口热气增加层次
data.mood: 柔弱、深情、令人不忍离去的温暖
data.promptProse: Seated with her knees tucked on the cushioned bedroom window seat while silent snow drifts past the glass, Setsuna Ogiso cradles a steaming mug against her cheek. Warm lamplight softens the ivory knit straps and ribbon bow of her pure white slip nightgown as she offers a tender, lingering smile.
data.animaCaption: Sitting on the cushioned window seat with snow falling outside, she holds a steaming mug and smiles tenderly.
data.nsfwProse: The soft ivory cashmere-knit slip drapes smoothly across her shoulders and collarbone in the warm bedroom glow.
